topic: User creation and access flow discussion
summary_markdown:
The conversation discusses the technical implementation for creating new users. Initially, a process was proposed where a user's company name and role would be captured, saved, and an email notification sent to administrators for manual setup.

[me] clarified that this initial idea was intended for OAuth-based user creation: create the user in a temporary/buffer company and notify an admin for transfer and proper role assignment. It was noted that while the plan shifted to using invitations (per someone else's input), no ticket had been created.

Later, [me] raised concerns about finding the code related to a closed Jira ticket on GitHub, which [unknown] explained was due to deleting an old branch and promising to push all changes today. The discussion also touched upon separating the UI work (which was ready) from the backend logic.
decisions: The technical implementation for user creation needs follow-up regarding code availability.
action_items: [unknown] to push all necessary code changes to GitHub today.
